claimed.note: A worker is running this TODO.
closed: This TODO is closed: nothing runs it.
proposalAny: Proposed: run with the suggested agent
run.title: Run this TODO unattended?
run.effect: It runs on its own: its questions are denied. It spends model budget.
approve.title: Approve this run?
approve.effect: The run starts now, unattended. It spends model budget.
cancel.title: Cancel this run?
cancel.effect: The worker stops. What it changed stays.
end.blocked: The run had already ended blocked.
end.failed: The run had already ended as failed.
end.none: How the run ended could not be read.
o.refused: The agent refused this. Nothing was changed.
o.refused.run: The agent refused to start the run. Nothing started.
o.refused.cancelRun: There was no run here to cancel, or another agent runs it.
o.refused.notFound: The agent could not find this TODO for you. Nothing was changed.
o.refused.notFoundProposal: The agent could not find this TODO or its proposal. Nothing was changed.
o.unsure.start: A worker may have started. Check again never starts another.
o.same: The TODO does not show it yet.
o.readFailed: The TODO could not be read. Try again later.
o.unsure.detail: Check again only reads; it sends nothing.
o.notSent.read: The TODO could not be read, so nothing was sent.
o.notSent.noRun: No run is going now. Nothing was sent.
o.cancel.answered: The agent took the cancel. The run's end is not read yet.
o.cancel.detail: Check again only reads; it sends nothing.
o.cancel.notYet: That run's end is not in the TODO yet.
o.cancel.unnamed: A run ended, but maybe not this one.
o.run.never: A lost Run cannot be confirmed from the TODO.
o.runSeen: A worker started at {{when}}: this run or another.
proposalExpired: Expired: it can no longer be approved.
held.proposals: Proposals wait until the worker's run ends.
o.notSent.changed: This changed, so nothing was sent.
confirm.unreadable: The TODO could not be read, or this is no longer offered.
o.now.approved: Approved, but the run may not have started.
busy: Another action on this TODO is not settled yet.
